decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Korean pronunciation/phonetics SME or speech/acoustic reviewer
findings: Reviewer feedback is ACCEPTABLE_FOR_ACCEPTANCE for WORD/EOJJEOL capability only after exact JSON inspection; the artifact now includes corrected 64-character dictionary identity, pinned model bytes, five-run command/config provenance, sample identity, and output identities.
conditionsAndLimitations: Formal acceptance confirmation and reviewer identity/authority are still absent.
Phone-tier release use and all speaking scores remain prohibited.

findings: 48-speaker demographic sample supplied; device, environment, proficiency, repeated-take, and SME labels remain missing.
conditionsAndLimitations: Synthetic perturbations cannot be accepted as genuine device/environment coverage.

decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Speech/acoustic reviewer or qualified Korean speech SME

decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Korean SME, acoustic reviewer, or fairness owner
findings: Alignment coverage is reported by available self-declared gender and age groups; score fairness is not established.
conditionsAndLimitations: Human score baselines and pre-approved disparity thresholds remain required.

decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Scoring, calibration, or release owner using pre-defined thresholds
findings: Five pinned offline runs aligned the same 47 samples, but only 41/47 word-label sequences were identical across all runs; p95 word-boundary delta was 10 ms and maximum was 490 ms.

The captured MFA logs show MFCC dither=1 and fMLLR=None. Two diagnostic runs changing only dither to 0 produced byte-identical TextGrid sets, isolating the repeatability trigger without treating the diagnostic as acceptance.
conditionsAndLimitations: The pre-registered 100 percent word-label identity and 100 ms maximum-boundary gates failed; automatic acceptance is forbidden.
A revised deterministic configuration must be registered before a fresh independent five-run evaluation.
